reasons.detail: The raw background is a varying hot-pink field rather than the requested literal flat #ff00ff key.
The edit request explicitly froze original cell roles, but the output substantially redrew the sheet and repeated the prior trial's invented dramatic phases.
Idle cells become attack roars and the locomotion row again uses airborne leaps instead of planted alternating support.
The ability row again introduces broad fire trails, detached energy, and ground eruptions forbidden by the corrective edit prompt.
The output remains glossy, sharply outlined, and neon-lit rather than preserving the original restrained painted material.

evaluation.notes: This trial tested whether a narrow edit-style request could preserve a mechanically usable production sheet while correcting only camera and torso height. It could not: the generator redrew action semantics and repeated the same airborne/effect defects. Full-sheet prompting is therefore rejected as the next production iteration; future work must isolate poses or assemble approved per-pose frames deterministically.

preparation.notes: Preparation can repair the key, cut, scale, and anchors but cannot restore the original clip roles or remove invented effects without changing authored art.

preparation.notes: Deterministic keying, decontamination, shared scaling, and fixed-foot placement are reproducible, and all three assessor mutations are caught. It cannot seed the other five Ashfang families or production.

The bottom-band contact oracle measures 19.1% of occupied walk-support columns persisting through all four phases, above the frozen 12% maximum. The same lower-center paw remains contact-like while moving laterally.
Independent runtime-scale review cannot track the required diagonal support ownership swap across cells 4-7; paw relocation reads as ground sliding rather than weight transfer.
Only three paws remain consistently readable at runtime scale because the fourth and far-side limbs merge into the torso and underside.
Walk cells 4-6 measure 184, 191, and 185 source pixels wide, exceeding the frozen 164-178 request and producing avoidable horizontal breathing despite acceptable height continuity.

evaluation.notes: The v8-derived raw sheet is quarantined. It restores the idle/walk height envelope, grounding, aspect, and loop measurements, but the new contact oracle now catches the same support-paw slide independently identified in exact-hash runtime review. Cells 4-7 still lack a trackable four-limb diagonal gait and exceed the requested width envelope. Production and later-family generation remain prohibited.

The persistent walk-contact ratio is 0.191 against the unchanged 0.12 maximum, so mechanical preparation and production promotion are rejected.
